notes: LANDED 2026-08-17 (with PB60 / AR-15.67.3-5). The container's configuration section applies to each directly or indirectly contained program: ConfigurationStep.Produce copies the whole configuration-derived state (SPECIAL-NAMES — DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA, CURRENCY SIGN, CLASS names, ALPHABETs, switch mnemonics and status condition-names; OBJECT-COMPUTER's PROGRAM COLLATING SEQUENCE; SOURCE-COMPUTER's DEBUGGING MODE; the REPOSITORY function/intrinsic/property specifiers) into every containee before it binds; the device-name mnemonics (Format 4, DISPLAY UPON / ACCEPT FROM) are a field of the same ConfigurationSlice (ConfigurationSlice.TryGetMnemonic, the unit's own entries first and its container's after), read by MnemonicRegistry. Implicit entries (the implied CURRENCY SIGN '$', the native alphabet) inherit as the defaults.
